items.problem: App.xaml.cs was corrupted by an in-place edit that duplicated the entire App class body, producing CS0102/CS0111 'App already contains a definition' errors.
items.evidence: session-log.txt turn 34 view shows two identical 'public partial class App' blocks; turn 35 the agent notes 'The edit accidentally doubled the class' and removes the duplicate; turn 36 build succeeds.
items.covered_clearly_at: SKILL.md line 181 (Fidelity): the 'never overwrite a whole bootstrap-copied file' / edit-in-place rule; and the general expectation that a class is defined once. This was a mechanical edit malfunction, not a knowledge gap — the agent self-diagnosed and fixed it in one turn.
items.why_no_skill_change: A capable model on re-run would not reliably reproduce this specific botched edit; it self-corrected within one turn without any missing guidance. Adding 'do not duplicate your class' prose would be noise.
